title: Forces: Pushes and Pulls
summary: What a force is, what it can do, and what happens when forces are balanced or unbalanced.

ib.note: Newton’s laws are formalised in MYP 4–5

objectives: I can describe a force as a push or pull, measured in newtons (N).
I can list what forces can do: start, stop, speed up, slow down, change direction or change shape.
I can find the net force and predict whether an object moves when forces are balanced or unbalanced.
misconceptions: A moving object needs a force to keep it moving.
If an object is not moving, no forces act on it.
Forces in the same tug-of-war cancel only if the teams are the same size.
